claim_boundaries: Generator test uses full multiplicative generator, nonzero Lagrange weights, q>2c; old order-(c+1) unit-weight test is distinct.
Point-versus-line uses whole-field parameter sampling, explicit q>=1000000d^3 and rejection<=1/4000000, conclusion distance<=2 rejection.
Bivariate theorem has individual degree<=d, d>0, q>=1000d^3; does not assert total degree<=d.
All local-correction probabilities refer to specified samplers; line-table correction only bounds accepted wrong answers.
Old-test counterexample is an ordinary symbolic derivation reviewed separately, not a Lean-checked result or new-priority claim.
Public arXiv v2 is not established identical to final SOSA proceedings edition.

Finite-dimensional linear algebra, determinant expansion and elementary field arithmetic
Elementary finite probability, union bound, Markov inequality
